rules: Use only development cases to compare or tune retrieval, chunking, prompts and models.
Freeze the pipeline configuration before running these cases.
Do not include questions, gold claims or relevance labels in embeddings, retrieval inputs or generation prompts beyond the selected test question.
Do not revise prompts or retrieval settings to repair observed holdout failures and report those repaired results as the original holdout score.
If a source or label error requires correction, retain the original case and document the revision separately.
scope: Five reserved synthetic questions on new source facts. Shared sources and behaviours with development cases; this is a small sanity check, not independent production validation.
source_snapshot: Existing parsed source IDs and locators; full source/configuration hashes frozen before final model comparison.
